decisions.decision: Current owner list is authoritative; old session/device/key/invite fenced; fresh realm keys and correct org/user key created. Older backup restored by later owner tested.

decisions.decision: Bound actual authoritative namespaces and blobs to head. Only current commit pointer hashes normalized; immutable base/old hashes retained. Stored cut pointers and attempt fingerprints separately checked.

decisions.finding: old IDs after copy, reopening wrong directory, HTTP spy missing binary capability
decisions.decision: Look up remapped copied block, reopen actual authority directory, forward actual admin/binary methods. Preserve original first failing log; corrected owning-source tests passed.

decisions.finding: required error to imply remote mutation never occurred even after valid dispatch
decisions.decision: Rejected that impossible rollback requirement. A previously authorized dispatched mutation may commit; stale frame receives no reply, old writer retains durable receipt/UNKNOWN, no resend/new-generation mixing. Separate pre-dispatch/pre-activation loss is blocked.

decisions.finding: worker deleted published credentials after uncertain SQL commit and recursively cleaned diagnostic destination
decisions.decision: Removed recursive cleanup and post-publication deletion. RESTORE_UNKNOWN preserves output/destination. Actual commit-ack fault injected after SQL commit proves new realm and credentials remain recoverable.
